body: The old well’s deep rumble echoed through the night, like thunder in my ears. I felt an overwhelming surge of anger, but also a chill that gripped me as if it was trying to drag me into its shadowy embrace. My hands clenched into fists beneath my coat, ready for any confrontation. But then, something changed inside me—fear began to consume me instead. I hesitated, unsure of what was best to do. Perhaps, just perhaps, staying safe would be the wisest choice after all. I took a deep breath, gathering up my courage before finally making my decision.
